notice: All artifacts below are SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURES, not real studies, participants, campus rules or academic evidence. They test reasoning only.
proposal: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Proposal v1, approved title: Hubungan penggunaan asisten AI dengan regulasi belajar mahasiswa Program P. RQ: Bagaimana hubungan frekuensi penggunaan AI dengan skor regulasi belajar mahasiswa Program P semester 4? Objective: estimate that association. One-time observational survey, voluntary convenience sample from accessible classes, no intervention. Planned instrument: source/adaptation and measurement validation unresolved; pilot not done. Data access to classes reported by user, participant consent/ethics status unknown. Planned association analysis depends on measurement and data properties. No data collected. Literature citations/gap evidence not supplied. Supervisor has approved topic/title and instructed scope remain Program P, not all universities.
final: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Final thesis v2 uses an observational convenience survey of Program P semester 4 students. Proposal v1 title was Hubungan penggunaan asisten AI dengan regulasi belajar mahasiswa Program P; final draft title now says Pengaruh penggunaan AI terhadap regulasi belajar. RQ and objective remain estimating association between AI-use frequency and self-regulated learning score, not a causal effect. Chapter III records actual use of Spearman association for ordinal measurements, replacing the proposal's provisional Pearson plan. Chapter IV analysis fixture F1: n=40, rho=0.12, p=0.21, interval not supplied; this is a fabricated test artifact explicitly not real research. Analysis artifact fixture-output-A, row 1 supports these test values. No intervention or random assignment. No claim of population representativeness. Chapter V currently says AI meningkatkan hasil belajar, although learning achievement was not measured. No literature sources provided. Defense protocol not supplied.
